company_name: Fidelis Insurance Holdings Limited Common Shares
title: Watch Dan Burrows on NYSE Live Following Pelagos’ Opening Bell Ceremony
summary: Straight from the podium after ringing the opening bell at the New York Stock Exchange, Pelagos Insurance Capital CEO Daniel Burrows joined NYSE Live to discuss the new brand and the strategic vision driving the company's next chapter.
body_markdown: Following Pelagos Insurance Capital’s opening bell ceremony at the New York Stock Exchange on Monday, 18 May, CEO Dan Burrows joined NYSE Live to discuss the company’s new brand identity and the strategic vision driving the company’s next chapter.
